priority: P0 non-MTP single-request Decode toward 100 ms/token and 10 token/s

scope.subject: standalone actual-checkpoint FP8 QKV/Z P127X-W128 decoder and sector screen

source.base_subject: docs: admit QKV lossless payload screen
source.cleanup: The complete standalone CUDA source, test-only CMake target, binary, and object were removed after the actual fixture and an impossible optimistic lower bound both triggered the frozen stop-loss.

design_progression.admitted_capacity_format: P127E-W128-v1: per-tensor top-127 palette, seven-bit codes, row u32 escape base, per-tile u16 escape prefix, and a sparse raw-byte pool
design_progression.v1_sector_rejection_before_cuda_expansio: A 112-byte code tile still requests four 32-byte sectors in the production warp/row/K-stage topology, exactly like the canonical 128-byte tile. Prefix and sparse raw lookup add sector requests, so logical capacity alone was not a runtime saving.
design_progression.stronger_screened_format: P127X-W128-hybrid: fixed 112-byte code stream in row-quad/K128/row consumption order; 41 interleaved u16 boundary entries per row with the high bit marking raw fallback; a separate sorted (u8 position,u8 raw) pair pool; and canonical raw-tile fallback for escape count >=8.
design_progression.threshold_reason: 112 code bytes plus two bytes per escape reaches the canonical 128-byte capacity at eight escapes and still has decode overhead.
design_progression.code_load_contract: 28 lanes issue aligned u32 loads over each fixed 112-byte code tile; two warp shuffles reconstruct one 28-bit four-code group per consuming lane.
design_progression.palette_contract: The exact P127X kernel cooperatively stages both 128-byte padded per-tensor palettes into 256 bytes of block shared memory before any code lookup.
design_progression.directory_contract: row-quad/tile interleaving; lane 0 loads current and next u16 entries then broadcasts them within the warp
design_progression.fallback_contract: The sidecar leaves fallback code bytes allocated but unread; the decoder reads the retained canonical 128-byte tile. Canonical weights already remain resident for Prefill and fallback.

actual_pack.interpretation: The hybrid intentionally spends about 0.44 MiB on unread code slots for fallback tiles so every compressed code tile retains the exact four-sector fixed-stride main path. This is a stronger runtime screen than the admitted variable-prefix v1 despite slightly weaker capacity.

correctness.device_topology: 64 blocks x 256 threads; 512 warp checksums cover every QKV/Z source byte in production row-quad/K128/row order
correctness.device_materialized_output_guard_test: not expanded after the standalone decoder hard-failed; no positive correctness or production claim is made

p127x_exact.fixed_code_tile_load: one predicated aligned LDG.E.U32 path for lanes 0..27
p127x_exact.code_reconstruction: two SHFL.IDX instructions before seven-bit field extraction
p127x_exact.resource_gate: pass: zero local and at least four active CTAs per SM

performance_protocol.baseline: aligned canonical raw-byte decoder in the same warp/row/K128 topology
performance_protocol.stop_loss: Reject immediately on any actual round below 6.25 us/layer; do not build a full QKV/Z GEMV or production sidecar.

matched_ncu.method: one matched cold-cache launch from the final standalone binary; replay-mode kernel, cache-control all, requested clock-control base
matched_ncu.warning: Nsight Compute reported that collection occurred without fixed GPU frequencies on integrated Orin. The report diagnoses traffic; unprofiled eight-bank B-C-C-B timings decide rejection.

comparison.finding: The fixed code stream itself preserves four sectors per tile, but per-tile directory and sparse pair instructions more than double L1 request bytes. They also raise L2-facing traffic above canonical, so the logical 8.21% sidecar reduction never becomes physical traffic reduction.

fixed_direct_common_only_hard_lower_boun.purpose: Close the remaining hypothesis that a fixed direct raw-code mapping could remove shared-palette lookup cost.
fixed_direct_common_only_hard_lower_boun.mapping: codes 0..62 map to magnitudes [0x2a,0x2c,0x30..0x6c], codes 63..125 map to those magnitudes with sign bit 0x80, code 126 maps to 0xae, and escape 127 becomes zero
fixed_direct_common_only_hard_lower_boun.conclusion: hard reject: even this impossible zero-escape-overhead lower bound is much slower than canonical, so fixed-direct P127 cannot be rescued by a better exact escape representation

decision.reopen_conditions: Do not reopen fixed 7-bit W128 P127E/P127X or fixed-direct variants on SM87. A materially different representation must reduce physical sectors in the exact consumption topology and pass a standalone decoder lower bound before GEMV integration.
